actual_hs_list: 293359 (heterocyclic compounds with nitrogen hetero-atom(s) only — pyrimidine/piperazine intermediates, e.g. anti-TB and HCV API intermediates); 293399 (other heterocyclic compounds with nitrogen hetero-atom(s)); 292249 (amino-acids/oxygen-function amino-compounds, other); 293214 (sucralose — NOT corroborated, no evidence of any sweetener/high-intensity-sweetener line)
product_summary: Website arenelifesciences.com (corporate office #3-58, S.R. Chambers, Ramachandrapuram, Hyderabad 502032, Telangana; info@arenelife.com) describes the company as a manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, 'since 2004', with stated focus on infectious diseases — anti-TB (mycobacteriology) and HCV — plus 'The Aerobic Bacteriology Section'. No itemised product/catalogue page is reachable: /products, /products/, /product/, /our-products/ and /sitemap.xml all return HTTP 404, so no individual molecule names, CAS numbers or grades could be read. Product-level mapping is therefore only at the therapeutic-class level: anti-TB and HCV APIs/intermediates are overwhelmingly N-heterocyclics (pyrazine/pyridine/piperazine/pyrrolidine/indole-type), which is consistent with 293359/293399; 292249 is plausible for amino-acid-type intermediates. Nothing is corroborated by a customs line — all product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared API/intermediate manufacturer with in-house R&D and 'manufacturing sites'; no trader signs found on the site — no 'we are a supplier/distributor of third-party brands' language, no trading-house wording). Not verified against any registry or customs record per scope.
comment: Industry misclassification: declared as 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG), but the company is a pharma API/intermediate manufacturer — the industry label is wrong and should be corrected to pharmaceuticals/API. HS assessment: 293359 and 293399 are consistent with the declared anti-TB/HCV heterocyclic API-intermediate profile (partial match, class-level only). 292249 is plausible but unconfirmed. 293214 (sucralose) is a clear outlier — a high-intensity sweetener has no relation to the stated API/intermediate portfolio and looks like a copy-paste/declaration error; it should be dropped unless a customs line proves a sucralose line. Per rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, codes corrected to the actual pharma profile, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Product lines missing from the declaration: no codes declared for the bulk of the API range beyond the four listed, and no code for any formulated dosage forms (3004) if such supply exists — cannot be determined. Note also the site carries obvious template artefacts (placeholder 'Lorem ipsum' text, a 'Chicago 12, Melborne City, USA' contact block, info@example.com), so the site is a partially built template and its product claims are weak evidence. Legal-name discrepancy: claimed 'ARENE LIFE SCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED' vs input 'ARENE LIFE SCIENCES LIMITED' — the site itself uses 'Arene Lifesciences Private Limited'; registry status not researched per scope. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data collected or asserted (null).
